title: Vitest
description: A blazing fast unit test framework powered by Vite.

data.text: Vitest is a unit testing framework powered by Vite. It is designed to be a drop-in replacement for Jest with faster execution via Vite's native ESM support and instant HMR during test runs.

data.title: A Simple Vitest Test
data.content: Write a test using Vitest's expect API.

data.title: Vite Integration
data.text: Vitest uses the same config and transforms as Vite, so no separate build configuration is needed.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Vitest uses Vite for instant test execution
data.takeaway: Vitest is the modern, fast alternative to Jest for Vite-based projects.
